pub fn sieve(limit: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut is_prime = vec![true; limit + 1];
    is_prime[0] = false;
    if limit > 0 { is_prime[1] = false; }
    for p in 2..=((limit as f64).sqrt() as usize) {
        if is_prime[p] {
            for i in (p * p..=limit).step_by(p) { is_prime[i] = false; }
        }
    }

}
